description: This file defines a utility function 'createLinkFromItem' that generates an ItemLink object for a given LinkableItem, indicating the relationship type ('linked' or 'linked-by'). It imports related types ItemLink and LinkableItem from local modules.

methods.name: export function createLinkFromItem<I extends LinkableItem = LinkableItem>( createLinkFromItem
methods.description: Generates an ItemLink object associating an item with a relationship type ('linked' or 'linked-by')
